rationale: Table1.tex column (1), row 'Missing jobs below new MW ($ \Delta $ b)' reports -0.018*** with clustered std. err. (0.004) on the line below it. This exactly matches the paper value of -0.018 (fraction of pretreatment total employment) with std. err. 0.004, and the significance stars (***) confirm the drop is significant. The replicated value is identical to the paper value, well within ±1σ. The fix_severity.json notes the estimation pipeline was ported from Stata (reghdfe) to R (fixest::feols) as a major-but-standard correspondence with only a small unverified-numerics risk; the produced Table1 estimate nonetheless matches the paper exactly, indicating the port faithfully reproduced this estimate.
